$comment: Text pool for the Family Issues prayer category.
requests: Pray for peace between my two brothers. They have not spoken in a year.
Our teenage daughter is pulling away from us. We need wisdom.
For my grandson, who is making some hard choices right now.
Asking for patience as we care for my dad at home.
My adult son stopped returning my calls. Praying he reaches out.
Healing in my family. That is all I can say right now.
Wisdom for us as new stepparents. Some days are really hard.
Please pray for my sister and me to find our way back to each other.
My husband and I are raising our two grandkids while their mom gets back on her feet. We love them so much, but we are tired. Pray for strength for us and for our daughter's recovery.
Our son is 16 and has started hanging around some kids who are not good for him. He is angry at us most days. Pray that he would see we love him and that he would make wise choices.
I have not talked to my daughter in almost two years. I do not even fully understand what went wrong. I miss her and my grandkids. Pray for a door to open.
Moving my mother in with us next month. She has early memory loss and is scared. Pray for her peace, and for grace for all of us as our home changes.
Asking prayer for my brother and sister. They had a falling out over our dad's care and now they will not be in the same room. It is breaking our mom's heart.
We are a blended family and it has been a rocky first year. My stepson does not want much to do with me. Pray I would be patient and kind and give it time.
Our oldest left home angry and has not been back. We do not know where he is staying. Pray for his safety and that he would remember he always has a home here.
Custody hearing coming up next week. I just want what is best for my kids. Pray for calm hearts on both sides and a fair outcome for the children.
For my neighbor, who is caring for her husband with dementia by herself. Her kids live out of state and she is worn out. Pray for help and for rest.
My parents are getting older and live back in Ohio. I feel torn between being here for my own family and being there for them. Pray for wisdom on what to do.
Things at home are tense. My husband and our adult son keep butting heads now that he has moved back in. Pray for peace in our house and for him to find his footing.
A coworker asked me to pray for her family. Her teenage daughter ran away for two days last week. She is home now, but everyone is shaken.
Thank you for praying for our family. My father-in-law is moving in with us, and our kids are not thrilled. Pray we all make room for each other, in the house and in our hearts.
Lord, soften my heart toward my sister. I know I have been holding a grudge for too long. Help me take the first step.
Our daughter just told us she is dropping out of college. We are trying not to react out of fear. Pray for good conversations and wisdom for her next steps.
Grandparents raising a toddler at 68 is not what we planned. We would not change it, but we need energy, patience, and a few good friends who understand.
My son and his wife are going through a hard time and it is affecting the grandkids. We do not want to overstep. Pray we know when to speak and when to just love them.
Would you pray for my mom? She is in her 80s and still insists on living alone in Mesa. We worry about her every day. Pray for her safety and for a peaceful talk about what is next.
Holidays are coming and my family does not do well together. Pray for kindness around the table this year, and for me to hold my tongue when I should.
Our 14-year-old has been lying to us about where she goes after school. We found out last week. Pray for trust to be rebuilt and for us to handle this with love.
Two of my kids have not spoken to each other since the wedding. I am stuck in the middle. Pray for both of them to let go of the hurt.
For my friend from work, who is going through a hard custody situation. She is scared and lonely. Pray she feels supported and that the kids are protected.
Pray for my stepdaughter as she adjusts to splitting time between two homes. She is only 9 and it is a lot for her. I want our home to feel safe for her.
My husband's family has never really accepted me. It has been 12 years. I am tired of trying. Pray for my heart and for some kind of breakthrough.
We had to take the car keys from my dad this week. He did not take it well and said some hurtful things. Pray for his dignity and for peace between us.
Our prodigal son called on his birthday for the first time in three years. It was short, but it was something. Pray this is the start of him coming home.
Asking prayer for my nephew. His parents split up last year and he has been acting out at school. He needs someone to show up for him.
Strength for my wife. She is caring for her mother every evening after work and has nothing left by the end of the week. Pray for rest and for her siblings to help.
Our blended family is finally under one roof. Five kids, two dogs, one bathroom. Pray for patience, a sense of humor, and real love to grow between the kids.
My brother and I have not talked since our mom's funeral. There was a fight over her house. I want to fix it but do not know how. Pray for courage and humility.
Please lift up my daughter-in-law. She and my son are struggling to parent their strong-willed boy and feel judged by everyone. Pray they feel encouraged.
I keep saying the wrong thing to my teenager. Every talk ends in a fight. Pray for gentler words from me and a softer heart in both of us.
My grandkids are being raised far away in Texas and their parents rarely let us visit. Pray for a good relationship with them even from a distance.
Asking for prayer for a friend in my small group whose adult daughter cut off contact with the whole family. She does not know why. Pray for answers and healing.
My mother and I clash about everything since she moved to Arizona to be near us. I love her, but it is hard. Pray for patience on both sides.
Our son is 22 and has moved out with no plan and no job. He says he is fine. We are not so sure. Pray he lets us help when he needs it.
For my uncle, who is the only one left caring for my grandma. He is burning out and the rest of us live far away. Pray for him and for us to step up.
Our family is in a hard season. There is a lot I cannot share, but God knows. Pray for wisdom, peace, and for each of us to choose kindness.
My ex and I are working on a new parenting plan. We do not agree on much, but we both love our kids. Pray for calm talks and for the kids to feel secure.

I have been carrying this for a long time and finally feel ready to ask. My oldest daughter walked away from our family and from her faith about five years ago. We have tried everything we know to do. Some days I am at peace, and some days I cry in the car before I go into work. Pray for her heart, for her safety, and for us to keep the porch light on no matter how long it takes.

Our family is going through a big change. My husband's dad can no longer live on his own, and after a lot of talking we decided he will move in with us. The kids have to share a room now, and my husband is grieving the dad he used to know. I want our home to be a place of grace, not resentment. Pray for each of us to adjust, and for my father-in-law to feel welcome and not like a burden.

This is for my brother's family back in Colorado. He and his wife are raising their two grandchildren after their son lost custody. They are in their 60s, on a fixed income, and learning school apps and car seats all over again. They love those kids fiercely. Pray for provision, energy, and a community around them so they do not feel alone.

We married two years ago and brought together my two boys and her daughter. On paper it all looked good. In real life the kids compete for attention, my wife and I disagree about discipline, and I feel like I am failing everyone. We have started family counseling. Pray that each child feels seen, that we get on the same page, and that we become a family, not just a household.

My teenage son has been making some choices that scare me. He has new friends, his grades have dropped, and he spends most nights in his room. When I try to talk, he shuts down. I know some of this is just growing up, but some of it is not. Pray for wisdom to know when to step in, for a mentor to come alongside him, and for him to know he is deeply loved.

My two adult kids have not spoken since a fight at Thanksgiving three years ago. Both of them call me and vent about the other, and I feel stuck in the middle. I miss having everyone at one table. I am not asking for a big reunion right away, just a crack in the wall. Pray for humility on both sides, and for me to stop trying to fix it and trust God with it.

Sharing this for a coworker who does not go to church but said I could. Her ex-husband is asking for full custody of their kids and she is terrified. She is a good mom. Pray for a fair judge, for good legal help, for the kids to be shielded from the conflict, and for her to sense that God is near even if she is not sure about Him yet.

It has been a hard year caring for my parents. Dad had a fall in the spring, and Mom is showing signs of memory loss. My siblings help when they can, but I live closest, so most of it falls on me. I am grateful to be able to do it, and I am also tired and a little resentful. Pray for my attitude, my energy, and for the right care to open up for them when the time comes.
details: It has been a long few months for our family, and we are running low on patience.
We are trying to love well without making things worse.
I know God loves them even more than I do. I am trying to rest in that.
Some days are better than others. Today was a hard one.
We would be grateful for any prayer, even just a quick one.
Pray also for the younger ones in the family, who see more than we think they do.
I keep replaying old conversations and wishing I had said things differently.
We have talked with our pastor and it helped. We still need prayer.
Pray for me to know when to speak and when to just listen.
There is a lot of history here, and none of it gets fixed overnight.
Our small group has been a big support, and we are thankful for them.
I am asking God to change my heart first, before anyone else's.
It feels heavy, but we are not giving up on each other.
My spouse and I do not always agree on how to handle it, so pray for unity between us too.
Sleep has been hard lately. My mind will not slow down at night.
We want to go into every conversation from here on with soft hearts.
Family is supposed to be a safe place. I want ours to be that again.
Thank you for caring about our family. It means more than you know.
"Yahweh is near to all those who call on him" (Psalm 145:18, WEB). I am holding on to that.
We are taking it one day at a time and trying to keep our eyes on Jesus.
answers: Things are calmer at home now. Thank you for standing with us.
God is moving in our family. It went better than I hoped.
Not fixed yet, but there has been a small step forward. Keep praying with us.
Still waiting, but I have real peace about it now. Thank you for praying.
We are in a much better place as a family. Thank you all so much.
A door opened that we did not expect. We are grateful and taking it slowly.
Nothing has changed on the outside, but God is changing my heart. That is an answer too.
There has been some healing. It is not all the way there, but it is real.
Praise God, things are so much better!
We are still in the middle of it, but we feel your prayers every day.
God has been faithful. The situation is improving week by week.
Some good news: there has been real progress, and everyone is doing a little better.
It is still hard, but we are not as stuck as we were. Thank you for not forgetting us.
We are waiting on God's timing. Our hearts are at peace even though nothing is settled yet.
Thank you for praying. We have seen grace in places we did not expect.
Answered! Not in the way I pictured, but in a better way.
Things are slowly getting better. Please keep praying for patience and kindness in our home.
We are not there yet, but there is hope in our family again. Thank you, church family.
